- Oval/ellipsoidal conidia at branch tips
- Photographer: Bruce Watt, image #5505971

- **Gray_Mold** (Botrytis): microscopy image showed branched conidiophores with oval conidia at tips — **MOST similar** to test image architecture
- **Alternaria**: showed elongated, beak-shaped multicellular conidia — clearly different
- **Late_Blight**: showed sympodial sporangiophores with large lemon-shaped sporangia — different
- **Anthracnose**: showed mass of cylindrical conidia — different
- **Rhizopus_Soft_Rots**: showed a single sporangium on a sporangiophore — different

The Gray Mold reference (image 5530080, 100 µm scale) showed the most structurally similar conidiophore branching pattern with oval conidia, matching Botrytis cinerea. All other classes with macroscopic-only references have no microscopy comparison available and are less likely.
